title: IRIDIUM: Real-Time Urban Mobility Prediction and Optimization Platform
description: IRIDIUM is a real-time urban mobility prediction and optimization platform for Azerbaijani cities. It is designed around federated machine learning, a dynamic digital twin of the transport network, multimodal routing, anomaly detection, and equity-aware mobility analytics. The platform uses real data sources (OSM, Open-Meteo, optional traffic and transit) when configured and exposes explicit data status when sources are unavailable. License: EUPL-1.2.
